name: Instrument
tagline: A dense, quiet frame: every corner, gap and tone is computed from three numbers. No accent colour; colour means status.
description: A whole cmux look (0.2.0) that draws the Instrument v0.1 design system as far as a look can, built only from public surfaces. Three seeds set everything: a 4 px grid, a 28 px row and 13 px chrome text. Corners follow one rule (a box's corner is the control corner plus its inset, never more than a third of its height); every fill is the theme's ink mixed into its surface at a multiple of 4% (frame 4, hover 8, selected and hairline 12, control line 16); text comes in three shares of the ink (100, 84, 68). There is no accent hue: selection is a neutral fill, links are the ink, and colour is kept for status. It leaves your glass, wallpaper and motion alone. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
